第1章 原主死了 我借体复活（第1页）
一道年轻俊俏的身影，躺在草丛上，两眼无神的看着天。
俊俏的少年保持这个动作，一动不动，大半天过去了。
少年突然坐了起来，活动下身体，喃喃自语的道：
“本来还以为我林羽年纪轻轻，就要去阎王府报到，想不到我竟然重生在异世界”
“没想到你也姓林，巧合的是，你跟我还是同样的岁数，还真是缘分不浅”
“想不到你出生的世家那么显赫，你过得却是那么悲惨，既然我林羽借了你的身体重生，那以后我就用了你的名字来活下去吧”
“你放心的去吧！你唯一放不下的娘亲，以后由我来替你照顾”
当林羽承诺许下时，感觉身体里面有什么东西，消失了一样，身体一下子轻松多了。
慢慢的查看林琅天的记忆，脸色也是由晴转多云，最后乌云密布，无法修炼，注定废柴，这搞个鬼喔。
由于心脏被挖，导致先天性不足，能活到十九岁，还是你娘亲苦苦哀求她娘家的人，赐下了紫心参，可以活二十年，才能短暂保住一命。
即便如此这还不算，还为林琅天定了一门亲事，对象是天荒大陆的三大荒古世家之一君家。
这样算什么，废物利用吗，有利价值彻底被压榨，做的也绝了点吧！
林羽整个人都懵逼了，这剧本不对啊，不是应该重生在君家吗。
然后出身就是巅峰，自己起点就是别人终点。
有点傻眼了，入赘在君家与重生在君家的差别。
那叫一个天上和地下，一个高贵无比，一个卑贱如泥。
林琅天的印象中，君家主脉年轻一代，有一龙两凤。
男子叫君傲天，大的叫君怡冰，小的君怡雪。
当初还在怀着君怡雪的时候，君家主母被禁地中的诡异存在种下过诅咒。
所以导致小女儿君怡雪的身体，出生就染上怪病，强如荒古世界君家也束手无策，只能勉强保下君怡雪的性命。
据小道消息传，君怡雪脸上长有一大块黑斑，异常吓人，
而且双脚无法下地，终日轮椅做伴。
再者又无法修炼，虽然可以吃延寿丹，但是终究会老去。
听说当时，为了这个事，君家还大动干戈，发动了帝战，重创了黑暗源头诡异存在，但也于事无补。
后来，君家传出消息，想要给自己的小女儿择一个上门女婿，希望有男子能在她有生之年，给她带来点快乐。
君家择婿，在天荒大陆可是大事，引起浩荡，无数门派的圣子，传人都想去碰碰运气。
可惜，君家小女却发话了，要找一个和她一样不能修炼的，又身有残疾的，因为君家小女自尊心强，这样觉得谁也不会耽误谁。
就这个条件，就把十之八九的人拦截在外，最后不知林家怎么回事，就把林琅天给顶了上去，而君家也是一拍即合。
林琅天知道这事后，就独自跑了出来，在这座悬崖上坐了几日几夜。
活的那么辛苦，丧失了对生活的念头，一个毫无修为的人，被冷风吹了几天几夜。
弄清了所有事情的缘由，林羽也是深深的叹了口气。
感觉自己重生，有点不合时宜，这又是废柴，又是身世憋屈，这日子没法过啊。
“修神辅助系统加载完成，正在开启…”
修神辅助系统已开启，正在绑定宿主…
“恭喜宿主，系统绑定完成，检查到宿主目前修为是个菜鸟，又是第一次绑定，
“宿主是否领取，若需领取，心里默念即可”
听到这一连串的声音，林羽先是懵逼，接着疯狂大笑起来。
“这才对嘛，这才是剧本的发展顺序嘛，前世看多了异界流小说，林羽是非常熟悉这种套路的”
“噢耶，没有宝贝助我修炼不要紧，没有老爷爷，老妖怪教我修炼也都不要紧”

Chapter 1 The original owner died and I resurrected through the body (Page 1)
A young and handsome figure was lying on the grass, staring blankly at the sky.
The handsome young man kept this action, motionless, and most of the day passed.
The young man suddenly sat up, moved his body, and murmured to himself:
"I originally thought that I, Lin Yu, would report to the Prince of Hell's Mansion at a young age, but I didn't expect that I would be reborn in a different world."
"I didn't expect that your surname is Lin. Coincidentally, you and I are still the same age. It's really a close relationship."
"I didn't expect that the family you were born into is so prominent, but your life is so miserable. Since I, Lin Yu, borrowed your body to be reborn, I will use your name to live on from now on."
"Go with peace of mind! The only mother you can't let go of, I will take care of it for you from now on."
When Lin Yu made the promise, he felt like something in his body had disappeared, and his body suddenly became much more relaxed.
Slowly checking Lin Langtian's memory, his face also changed from sunny to cloudy, and finally dark clouds, making him unable to practice and doomed to be useless. What a heck.
Due to congenital deficiencies due to his heart being dug out, he was able to live to the age of nineteen. It was your mother who begged her parents to give her the purple heart ginseng, which allowed her to live twenty years before she could survive for a short period of time.
Even so, that's not all. Lin Langtian was also arranged to be married to the Jun family, one of the three ancient aristocratic families in the Tianhuang Continent.
What does this mean? It's waste utilization. The beneficial value is completely squeezed. What a great job!
Lin Yu was completely confused. This script was wrong. Shouldn't he be reborn in the Jun family?
Then one’s birth is the peak, and one’s starting point is other people’s ending point.
I was a little dumbfounded by the difference between marrying into the Jun family and reborn into the Jun family.
That's called heaven and earth, one is extremely noble, and the other is as humble as mud.
In Lin Langtian's impression, the younger generation of the Jun family has a dragon and two phoenixes.
The man's name is Jun Aotian, the older one's name is Jun Yibing, and the younger one's name is Jun Yixue.
When she was still pregnant with Jun Yixue, the Jun family's mistress was cursed by a strange presence in the forbidden land.
As a result, the body of the youngest daughter Jun Yixue was infected with a strange disease at birth. The Jun family in the ancient world was helpless and could only barely save Jun Yixue's life.
According to rumors, Jun Yixue has a large black spot on her face, which is extremely scary.
Moreover, he cannot get off the ground with his feet, so he is always in a wheelchair.
Furthermore, you cannot practice cultivation. Although you can take life-extending pills, you will eventually grow old.
I heard that at that time, because of this matter, the Jun family went to war and launched an imperial war, which severely damaged the strange existence of the source of darkness, but it did not help.
Later, news came out from the Jun family that they wanted to choose a son-in-law for their youngest daughter, hoping that a man could bring her some happiness during her lifetime.
The choice of a son-in-law for the Jun family is a big event in the Tianhuang Continent, causing great uproar. The saint sons and descendants of countless sects want to try their luck.
It's a pity that the little girl of the Jun family has spoken out and wants to find someone who can't practice like her and is disabled. Because the little girl of the Jun family has a strong self-esteem, she thinks that no one will be delayed.
On this condition, nine out of ten people were intercepted. In the end, not knowing what was going on with the Lin family, they pushed Lin Langtian up, and the Jun family also hit it off.
After Lin Langtian knew this, he ran out alone and sat on the cliff for several days and nights.
Living so hard, I lost my thoughts on life. A person with no cultivation was blown by the cold wind for several days and nights.
After figuring out the reasons for everything, Lin Yu also sighed deeply.
I feel that my rebirth is a bit out of place. I am a loser and have an aggrieved life experience. I cannot live this life.
"The God Cultivation Auxiliary System has been loaded and is starting..."
The god-cultivation auxiliary system has been turned on and is binding to the host...
"Congratulations to the host, the system binding is completed. It is found that the host's current cultivation level is a rookie. This is the first binding.
"Whether the host wants to receive it? If you need to receive it, just say it silently in your heart."
Hearing this series of sounds, Lin Yu was confused at first, and then laughed crazily.
"That's right. This is the order of development of the script. In his previous life, he read too many otherworldly novels. Lin Yu is very familiar with this routine."
"Oh yeah, it doesn't matter if I don't have a baby to help me practice. It doesn't matter if I don't have a grandfather or an old monster to teach me how to practice."
